items.title: Use of Firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Antivirus Tools (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Use of Firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Antivirus Tools (PDF 127, printed 123).

blocks.text: Firewall computer aur internet ke darmiyan deewar (barrier) ka kaam karti hai: mehfooz data ko guzarne deti hai aur nuqsan-deh traffic ko rokti hai. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) networks par mashkook (suspicious) sargarmi dekhte rehte hain aur users ko mumkin khatron se khabardar karte hain. Antivirus software files scan karta hai aur viruses ya malware ko nuqsan karne se pehle hata deta hai. Mil kar yeh tools cyberattacks ke khilaf taqatwar difa banate hain. Inhein baqaida use karna computers aur networks ko mehfooz aur theek chalta rakhta hai.

blocks.caption: Teen defence tools
rows: Computer aur internet ke beech deewar; mehfooz data andar, nuqsan deh traffic band
Network par mashkook sargarmi dekh kar alert deta hai
Files scan kar ke virus ya malware nuqsan se pehle hata deta hai

blocks.prompt: Firewall aur IDS mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Firewall computer aur internet ke beech rukawat (barrier) hai jo mehfooz data guzarne deti aur nuqsan deh traffic rokti hai. IDS network ko dekhta rehta hai aur mashkook sargarmi par user ko alert (khabar) deta hai.

items: Firewall rokti hai, IDS khabar deta hai, antivirus scan kar ke malware hatata hai.
